description:
FOUND AND FIXED under fz-5xp.22, by the coverage audit rather than by accident.

Interpreted ENTRY dispatch never matched a map pattern whose key is a binary.

  fnp lookup(%{"name" => name}), do: {:named, name}
  fnp lookup(%{}), do: :anonymous

  lookup(%{"name" => "ada"})     run: {:named, "ada"}   interp: :anonymous
                                 elixir: {:named, "ada"}

A three-door divergence, silent: the clause was simply skipped and the next one
matched, so the program produced a plausible wrong answer rather than failing.

MECHANISM. A map pattern keyed by a binary is decided through a PREPARED key.
`dispatch_const_key_value` (ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs:585) finds the key's index
in `plan.prepared_keys` and reads the materialised value out of the pinned map;
Int/Float/Atom/Bool/Nil keys are decoded from the constant directly and never
consult it. The receive path fills that map from its bindings
(`local_dispatch_pinned`, ir_interp/backend.rs:1878) and native entry dispatch
pushes them itself (jobs/native.rs:2631, `prepared_key_name`), but interpreted
entry dispatch called `select_dispatch_match(..., &HashMap::new())` -- an EMPTY
map. The lookup found nothing, the region answered "key absent", and the clause
was skipped.

FIX: `prepared_dispatch_keys` materialises each Utf8Binary prepared key through
`fz_alloc_bitstring_const` before entry dispatch runs, which is what the other
two doors already had.

WHY IT SURVIVED: no behavioural fixture exercised `map_key`/`map_kind` on entry
dispatch. Both regions had exactly two covering fixtures and BOTH were
`receive_*`, so the regions were gated only on the receive matcher. Coverage of
a region is not coverage of a region AT A DISPATCH SITE. Pinned now by
fixtures2/behavior/map_clause_dispatch.fz against an Elixir twin.

Same class as fz-5xp.18 (one question answered per-door, drifting) and fz-5xp.1
(a stub arm that compiled because exhaustive matching forces an arm to exist,
not to be correct).
title: Interpreted entry dispatch never matched a binary-keyed map pattern
